title: Auth Control Plane membership (v1 wire format)
description: A principal's membership of an organization (auth.memberships). role is an organization role key and is null until the membership is active; an active membership always holds a role. status is the resource spelling (invited); provisioning events spell the same state pending (README).

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

membership_id.description: Membership id. Server-minted, never copied from caller input.

role.description: An organization role key of the closed catalog (contracts/auth/v1/vocabulary/roles.v1.json). A platform role, superuser and every other value are refused. Null while the membership is not active.

status.description: Closed set; equal to the memberships status CHECK.

revision.description: Aggregate revision (provisioning-event.v1 payload.revision). Integer token only; a decimal-form token is refused by every client (README, integer guard).

joined_at.description: When the member accepted; null until then.
